_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::beams#1 — a beam DESIGN POINT DIRICH block whose NUMDOF does not match the element's DOF count is caught by the DBC reader, which prints '3 DOFs given but 6 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition' from core/fem/src/discretization/4C_fem_discretization_utils_dbc.cpp. The entry's older wording 'inconsistent DOF count for beam element' exists in no 4C source file and is asserted absent. Worth knowing about the shape of the failure: the mesh has already been read and fill_complete()d when this fires, so the log looks healthy right up to the abort. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) on upstream deck beam3r_line2_static_test1.4C.yaml.
expect_in_output: 3 DOFs given but 6 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition
